findings.title: Privileged user can register a synced passkey
findings.subject: gina@fabrikam.example
findings.detail: gina@fabrikam.example (Exchange Administrator) can register: Synced passkey, any provider, unattested. Their stricter admin profile is overridden.
evidence: gina@fabrikam.example holds privileged role(s): Exchange Administrator
member of 'Vendors EU' → 'Contractors' (nested) → scoped to profile 'Contractors'
member of group 'IT Admins' → scoped to profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)'
Profile 'Contractors': deviceBound + synced; no attestation; no AAGUID restriction
Profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)': deviceBound + synced; attestation required; allow-list of 1 AAGUID(s)
Microsoft rule: a passkey is allowed if it satisfies at least one scoped profile; there is no most-restrictive-wins.
Effective weakest credential: Synced passkey, any provider, unattested (permitted by 'Contractors')
The stricter profile(s) 'Admins - security keys (attested)' never get a say for this credential.
findings.action: Exclude privileged users from the target(s) 'Contractors' of the loose profile (e.g. scope it to a group that excludes admins), and scope admins only to a device-bound, attested profile.

findings.title: SMS/voice-only user
findings.subject: liam@fabrikam.example
findings.detail: liam@fabrikam.example relies only on sms. Blocking registration prompt from 1 Feb 2027.
evidence: Registered MFA methods: sms (no non-phone MFA method)
User category: member
Deadline cohort: 1 Feb 2027; 102 day(s) from 2026-10-22
Passkey policy status: Device-bound, attested, allow-listed authenticators only
findings.action: Have the user register a passkey (device-bound preferred) before the deadline.

findings.key: R5|user|hank@fabrikam.example|Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
findings.title: Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
findings.subject: hank@fabrikam.example
findings.detail: hank@fabrikam.example's key 'YubiKey 5' (AAGUID cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8) satisfies none of their profiles.
evidence: Registered key: YubiKey 5, deviceBound, AAGUID cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8
Profile 'Workforce - Authenticator only': deviceBound; attestation required; allow-list of 2 AAGUID(s) → rejects this key
findings.action: Add AAGUID cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8 to an allow list that covers this user, or have them register a permitted key before the change lands.

findings.key: R5|user|jack@fabrikam.example|Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
findings.title: Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
findings.subject: jack@fabrikam.example
findings.detail: jack@fabrikam.example's key 'YubiKey 5 NFC (FW 5.7)' (AAGUID a4e9fc6d-4cbe-4758-b8ba-37598bb5bbaa) satisfies none of their profiles.
evidence: Registered key: YubiKey 5 NFC (FW 5.7), deviceBound, AAGUID a4e9fc6d-4cbe-4758-b8ba-37598bb5bbaa
Profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)': deviceBound + synced; attestation required; allow-list of 1 AAGUID(s) → rejects this key
findings.action: Add AAGUID a4e9fc6d-4cbe-4758-b8ba-37598bb5bbaa to an allow list that covers this user, or have them register a permitted key before the change lands.

findings.key: R6|profile|Admins - security keys (attested)|Attested profile lists synced passkeys
findings.title: Attested profile lists synced passkeys
findings.subject: Admins - security keys (attested)
findings.detail: 'Admins - security keys (attested)' requires attestation and also lists synced passkeys. Synced passkeys cannot be attested, so that setting is dead weight and suggests a misunderstanding.
evidence: Profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)': deviceBound + synced; attestation required; allow-list of 1 AAGUID(s)
Attestation is not possible for synced passkeys (Microsoft Learn).
findings.action: Remove 'synced' from this profile, or drop the attestation claim and document it as a synced profile.

findings.key: R6|profile|Admins - security keys (attested)|Attested profile is bypassed by an overlapping profile
findings.title: Attested profile is bypassed by an overlapping profile
findings.subject: Admins - security keys (attested)
findings.detail: 1 of 2 users scoped to attested profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)' can still register unattested passkeys through another profile.
evidence: Users affected: gina@fabrikam.example
Union semantics: the attested profile only constrains users who have no looser profile.
findings.action: Remove the users of 'Admins - security keys (attested)' from the targets of looser profiles, or accept that 'Admins - security keys (attested)' is not an attestation control for them.

findings.title: Registration campaign is off
findings.subject: tenant
findings.detail: 1 SMS/voice-only user(s) and no registration campaign to nudge them before the deadline.
evidence: Campaign state: disabled
findings.action: Enable the registration campaign for the SMS/voice cohort, targeting passkeys, with limited snoozes.

findings.key: R10|profile|Pilot (unused)|Profile not targeted by any group
findings.title: Profile not targeted by any group
findings.subject: Pilot (unused)
findings.detail: 'Pilot (unused)' is defined but no include target uses it. It protects nobody.
findings.action: Target it at the intended group or delete it.

findings.title: Many passkey profiles
findings.subject: tenant
findings.detail: 4 profiles (soft threshold 3). More profiles mean more overlap to reason about.
evidence: Workforce - Authenticator only, Admins - security keys (attested), Contractors, Pilot (unused)
findings.action: Consolidate to an admin profile and a workforce profile where possible.

findings.key: R10|profile|Workforce - Authenticator only|Authenticator AAGUIDs in allow list
findings.title: Authenticator AAGUIDs in allow list
findings.subject: Workforce - Authenticator only
findings.detail: 'Workforce - Authenticator only' allows Microsoft Authenticator AAGUIDs, which Entra adds automatically when Authenticator passkeys are enabled.
findings.action: Confirm Authenticator passkeys are intended for the users of this profile.

R1.name: Overlap weakening
R1.definition: A privileged user can register a weaker passkey than the admin profile intends, because at least one scoped profile allows it.

R2.name: Weak key already held
R2.definition: A privileged user already holds a synced or unattested passkey.

R3.name: Deadline cohort
R3.definition: User's only MFA is SMS or voice. They hit a blocking passkey registration prompt on 1 Feb 2027 (Global Admins and external users: 1 Jul 2027).

R4.name: Auto-enabled admin
R4.definition: A privileged SMS/voice user sits in an 'all passkey types' profile, the shape Microsoft auto-enabled on 1 Sep 2026.

R5.name: AAGUID trap
R5.definition: A user holds a passkey that none of their scoped profiles accepts. Microsoft blocks keys whose AAGUID is not permitted, so they lose sign-in with it.

R6.name: Attestation illusion
R6.definition: A profile is relied on as 'attested' but synced passkeys cannot be attested, or its users can bypass it through another profile.

R7.name: No phishing-resistant method
R7.definition: A privileged user has no phishing-resistant method registered.

R8.name: Campaign gap
R8.definition: The registration campaign will not reliably move the SMS/voice cohort to passkeys before the deadline.

R9.name: Excluded but privileged
R9.definition: A privileged user is excluded from the passkey policy. Exclusion beats every inclusion, so they cannot use passkeys at all.

R10.name: Policy hygiene
R10.definition: Profile count, list size, unused or dangling references, and auto-added Authenticator AAGUIDs.

notes: Per-user FIDO2 detail is exported for privileged users and the SMS/voice cohort only, which keeps Graph calls bounded. Rules that read registered keys (R2, R5) cover that scope.
